```

```

```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude)|>distinct()|>rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
```

```{r}
bird_migration_selected<-bird_migration_sites|>select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat)|>distinct()|>rename(Winter_Longitude=winterLongitude,Winter_Latitude=winterLatitude,Stopover_Longitude=pslon,Stopover_Latitude=pslat,Iberian_Longitude=iblon,Iberian_Latitude=iblat,Westmost_Longitude=awestlon,Westmost_Latitude=awestlat)

gt(head(bird_migration_selected))
```

```{r}
bird_breeding_dartmoor <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site == "Dartmoor")

gt(bird_breeding_dartmoor)
```

```{r}
bird_breeding_not_dartmoor <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Dartmoor")

gt(bird_breeding_not_dartmoor)
```

```{r}
bird_breeding_long_10 <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Breeding_Longitude > 10)

gt(bird_breeding_long_10)
```

```{r}
bird_breeding_exc<-bird_breeding_selected|>filter(Site!="Spain")
gt(bird_breeding_exc)
bird_migration_exc<-bird_migration_selected|>filter(Site!="Spain")
gt(head(bird_migration_exc))
```

```{r}
bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)
glimpse(bird_migration_grouped)
```

```{r}
lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE))

gt(lat_df)
```

```{r}
lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lowest_Lat_Stopover = min(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Lat_Stopover = mean(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Highest_Lat_Winter = max(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lowest_Lat_Winter = min(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Lat_Winter = mean(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

gt(lat_df)
```

```{r}
bird_migration_grouped<-bird_migration_exc|>group_by(Site)
bird_migration_summary<-bird_migration_grouped|>summarise(Stopover_Longitude=median(Stopover_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                  Stopover_Latitude=median(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE) ,
                                                  Iberian_Longitude=median(Iberian_Longitude,na.rm = TRUE),      Iberian_Latitude=median(Iberian_Latitude,na.rm = TRUE) ,Westmost_Longitude=median(Westmost_Longitude,na.rm = TRUE),   Westmost_Latitude=median(Westmost_Latitude,na.rm = TRUE) ,      Winter_Longitude=median(Winter_Longitude,na.rm = TRUE) ,       Winter_Latitude=median(Winter_Latitude ,na.rm=TRUE)                      )
gt(bird_migration_summary)
```

```{r}
combined_bird_data<-full_join(bird_breeding_exc,bird_migration_summary)
gt(combined_bird_data)
```

```{r}
combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_Longitude", "_Latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
  )

gt(combined_bird_piv)
```

```{r}
keep_sites_spring<- c("Breeding","Stopover","Winter")
keep_sites_autun<- c("Breeding","Iberian","Westmost","Winter")

spring_data<-combined_bird_piv|>filter(Location_Type %in% keep_sites_spring)

autumn_data<-combined_bird_piv|>filter(Location_Type%in%keep_sites_autun)

gt(spring_data)
gt(autumn_data)
```

```{r}
write_csv(spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")
```
